notes: Item 19 discloses Gross Revenue figures only (no cost, profit, or margin data). Data covers franchised TruBlue outlets for the year ending December 31, 2025. Eligible cohort: 42 of 135 total franchises (41 excluded for opening in 2025; others excluded for not meeting full-time/handyman/continuous-ownership criteria). Data presented by quartile (Q1-Q4) plus cumulative and a first-full-year cohort. All values are annual. Gross Revenue is defined on an accrual/billing basis and does not reflect operating costs or franchisor fees.
